name: unchanged-verify-progress-ab
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-30, before any run. HYPOTHESIS: making the anti-spiral gate reachable (BANTAM_UNCHANGED_VERIFY_PROGRESS=0) reduces turns burned in the recorded read->test spiral on keyed-task-pool. PRIMARY METRIC: turns to termination (the spiral cost 26 of 40 turns in round-03; baseline was 40/33/40). SECONDARY: progressGateRejections and progressGateTerminations must become non-zero in the candidate arm -- if they stay 0 the fix did not engage and nothing else is interpretable; plus reachedDone and pass. HARM METRIC, pre-registered because this is the specific risk of the change: a gate that now fires during legitimate edit->verify->inspect cycles would show up as FEWER edits or as a candidate arm that terminates early WITHOUT reaching done. Report it whichever way it falls. This is well-powered unlike the lexical A/B: the spiral reproduced 3/3, so the triggering condition is always present. FALSIFIED IF: turns do not drop, or the gate fires but the arm ends worse.
